queries: WITH equipment_avg AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_avg FROM equipment_avg), kept AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity FROM equipment_avg e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE e.avg_humidity > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_humidity, k.avg_humidity - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, ABS(k.avg_humidity - m.kept_avg) AS distance_from_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN kept_mean m WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND m.kept_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY distance_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: “How far” means absolute distance from the kept-equipment mean. Equipment with no humidity readings has no average and is excluded.
